cases.why: the warning moves past the Weekly update's lock slack, so a Thursday run could miss the kickoff before anyone was warned.
a cron line with 7 for Sunday never matches, so a Sunday slot is missed and the delay measured from the slot before.
day of month and day of week are ANDed, unlike GitHub's cron, which ORs them.
the earliest of several slots is taken, so a run on time for Monday's slot reads as a day late for Sunday's.
cases.find: return max(found) if found else None
cases.replace: return min(found) if found else None
